title: Pin the brief Markdown grammar to CommonMark with a captured render oracle
body:
Outcome: the brief checker's Markdown grammar (src/brief/index.ts outsideFences) is pinned to CommonMark by an observer that compares section visibility with a verbatim GitHub GFM render capture (KRN-12), covering an inline `<!--` before an ATX heading and a multi-line paragraph above a setext underline; the review lens tells judges that a Markdown-grammar BLOCKING finding must cite CommonMark block/inline order or a rendered proof.
Evidence: PR #162 attempt 8 (record review-series/a3b6e8ee…/records/1.json) lost one panel vote to a false positive at src/brief/index.ts:77; GFM render in .krn/archive/worktree-runs/feat-hardening-checklist-20261102T075404Z/claude/hardening-checklist/lead/finding-8-gfm-render.md; operator approved the override.
